verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench, so a JetBrains IDE integration is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence shows a JetBrains plugin, interactive diffs inside the IDE, or sharing selected code as context; the evidence covers only a desktop app, a web UI, a TUI, and remote SSH/WSL. The '20+ coding tools' claim refers to coding tools such as Claude Code, not IDE integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
